label: The collapse lemma: a theory whose answer map matches another's on every…, by Conditional-proof
meaning: Assume T matches R on every question. Where R answers and its answer holds, T answers (they agree on whether there is an answer) and its equivalent answer holds; and a question where T deviates would contradict the match there, so T is no distinct rival. Discharging the assumption gives the lemma for all answer maps. Pure logic: no premises, no axioms.
